projects.name: TrayPilot
projects.audience: For Windows 11 users who want display, audio and network controls one click away in the system tray.
projects.tagline: Monitor brightness, audio switching and network stats, one click from the tray.
projects.excerpt: A compact Windows 11 flyout that keeps everyday controls close: adjust supported monitors, pick playback devices, watch live throughput and tweak common settings. You choose the shortcut that opens it.
features: Adjust brightness on supported monitors, with a laptop-panel fallback
Switch playback devices and mute speakers or microphones in one click
See download and upload speeds from active network adapters
Shortcuts for theme, Night Light, power mode, desktop icons and screen lock
Pick your own keyboard shortcut to bring up the panel
limits: Require sign-in, cloud sync or usage tracking
Use the microphone or capture your screen

projects.name: ClerkBrain
projects.audience: For anyone with piles of invoices and receipts who wants them sorted without uploading them anywhere.
projects.tagline: Local AI that sorts receipts and invoices in your Downloads folder, without uploads.
projects.excerpt: ClerkBrain keeps an eye on the folders you pick, reads incoming paperwork (PDFs, Office files, photos and scans), pulls out the key figures and lets you search or ask questions about it. Naming and filing suggestions wait for your approval, and the on-device AI never sends your files elsewhere.
features: Works through PDFs, Office files, photos and scans in the folders you select
Reads out supplier, date, total and invoice number
Finds files by keyword, or by meaning once the optional AI models are installed
Answers plain-language questions and points to the source documents
Suggests names and folders, with undo on every change
Marks uncertain readings and flags duplicates and leftovers
Builds a year-end pack for your accountant
limits: Send your documents anywhere. The AI runs on your device
File anything without asking. Auto-filing stays off until you switch it on

projects.name: Craft Fair Profit
projects.audience: For craft sellers planning a fair who want to know whether it will be worth the cost.
projects.tagline: Offline planning for craft fairs: stock, costs, takings and break-even at a glance.
projects.excerpt: Work out whether a craft fair is worth the effort before you book. Track stock, expenses and sales for each event, then review what to bring and what the day actually earned.
features: Keep stock counts, costs and sales together for each event
Estimate break-even before you commit to a stall
Checklists for what to pack and what to record
Review each event afterwards to see what paid off

projects.name: Fix My Photo Library
projects.audience: For anyone with a messy photo library full of duplicates who wants to clean it up safely.
projects.tagline: Confirm your photo backups, clear duplicates and check image health, all on your PC.
projects.excerpt: Compare backups by content so renamed copies still count, remove exact duplicates with an undo option, flag damaged images and review camera date information. Changes are reversible and nothing is uploaded.
features: Confirms backups by comparing contents, so renamed copies still match
Finds identical files and moves the extras into a reversible quarantine
Scans images for decoding faults, separating real damage from unsupported formats
Checks camera date and timezone details before touching timestamps
Restores a damaged photo from a healthy backup as a separate, verified copy
limits: Rewrite EXIF metadata or invent missing timezone offsets
Send your photos anywhere for processing

projects.name: Fix My Photo Dates
projects.audience: For people whose photo dates went wrong after a Google Takeout export or moving files around.
projects.tagline: Repair photo timestamps lost during Takeout exports, cloud downloads or file moves.
projects.excerpt: When dates go wrong after an export or a move, this tool finds the mismatch, shows the proposed fix and lets you roll it back. Everything runs on your Windows PC.
features: Diagnoses and fixes timestamps after Takeout exports, iCloud downloads and file moves
Shows a preview before any change and lets you roll it back
All processing stays on your Windows PC

projects.name: RenameFromFolder
projects.audience: For anyone who keeps files in well-named folders and wants the filenames to match.
projects.tagline: Name files after the folders they sit in, with a preview before anything changes.
projects.excerpt: Prefix every file in a folder tree with its parent folder's name. You see each change first, and you can reverse the whole batch afterwards. Works on Windows 10 and 11.
features: Prefixes each file with the name of its parent folder, including subfolders
Shows every planned rename before anything is applied
Reverses a whole batch whenever you need to
Runs on Windows 10 and 11

projects.name: ShelfSearch
projects.audience: For people whose files are spread across several drives and who need to find things fast.
projects.tagline: Search your external drives and network shares, even while they're unplugged.
projects.excerpt: ShelfSearch builds a local index of filenames and folder paths from each drive you register. When a drive is offline you still see where a file lives, so you know which disk to plug back in.
features: Registers external and removable drives, mapped drives and chosen network shares
Lets you search while a drive is disconnected, and shows where it lives
Displays each drive's connection status, capacity and free space
Exports search results to a CSV file
Keeps the index on your own PC
limits: Open or inspect the files on your drives
Send anything off the machine, or depend on a cloud service to work

projects.name: What Was I Working On?
projects.audience: For anyone who loses track of what they were working on and needs to get back to it quickly.
projects.tagline: Get back to the file you had open yesterday, found in seconds from a single shortcut.
projects.excerpt: Recent files and folders are collected into a searchable history. A quick overlay or a full timeline lets you reopen the right item, and the record never leaves your machine.
features: Opens a quick overlay of recent work from a shortcut
Browses a full timeline: today, yesterday, past 7 days and past 30 days
Filters by name, folder, app or file extension
Reopens files and folders straight from the timeline
Optional Windows 11 widget and reminders for supported apps
Scans known app recovery folders, only when you start it
Stores history and recovery copies encrypted
limits: Need an account, cloud service, telemetry or internet access
Upload your history or document contents

projects.name: Tower Defence Riftward
projects.audience: For tower defence fans who want to hold the line against an elemental siege.
projects.tagline: A tower defence campaign of elemental sieges across four routes and sixty waves.
projects.excerpt: Plan your defences across four routes, combine nine tower families and hold out through sixty escalating waves in a single-player campaign.
features: A single-player campaign built around elemental towers
Choose from four routes
Nine families of towers to build and combine
Sixty waves of escalating attacks

projects.name: Blobheads Voleyball Arcade
projects.audience: For anyone who enjoys quick head-to-head arcade games, against the computer or a friend on one keyboard.
projects.tagline: A reimagined arcade volleyball game for Windows, played against the computer or a friend.
projects.excerpt: Blobheads Voleyball Arcade is a reimagined take on arcade volleyball. Rally against the computer, share a keyboard with a friend in local two-player, or work through the four-round Green, Yellow, Orange and Red tournament.
features: A reimagined take on arcade volleyball
Matches against the computer, or a friend on the same keyboard
A four-round Green, Yellow, Orange and Red tournament
Keyboard, mouse and controller support

projects.name: Puzzlotski Puzzle
projects.audience: For sliding-block puzzle fans who want an original set of levels to work through.
projects.tagline: A reimagined sliding-block puzzle with its own original levels, on the Microsoft Store.
projects.excerpt: Puzzlotski Puzzle is a reimagined sliding-block puzzle with an original set of levels. It's a one-time paid download from the Microsoft Store.
features: A reimagined sliding-block puzzle
An original set of levels to work through
